Re: The Mouse In The Mug

Tom McElvogue’s current website (@Jan 2022) doesn’t include his compositions or information about them, but one can still access the removed former pages via the Internet Archive/wayback machine here: https://web.archive.org/web/20110724012916/http://www.tommcelvogue.com/music.html#tabs=3 (click the 4th box down on the left to access the “About the Compositions” page and its sub-pages) - including his statement of his authorship of The Mouse in the Mug - in the discography of recordings of his tunes by other players (“Where some of these compositions have ended up”). Unfortunately he doesn’t seem ever to have recorded it himself, nor provided a notation of his original as-composed version.

↳ Posted by Jemtheflute on January 17th, 2022.

The Mouse In The Mug, X:8

This setting is as played by the fiddler Tommy McConville on his 2008 album Tommy on the Bridge. He called it “Thomas McElvogue’s” and says it was “…written by the flute virtuoso Thomas McElvogue who came from the next street to me in Newcastle.”

↳ Posted by Nigel Gatherer on January 19th, 2025.
